wx: The George B. Horton and Amanda Bradish Farmstead is a privately owned farmhouse that sits on 40 acres of land at 4650 West Horton Road in rural Fairfield Township in Lenawee County, Michigan. It was added to the National Register of Historic Places on February 1, 2007.
